title: Heat Check, Week 5
dek: Sample risers and fallers with the number that backs each read.
author: Chef Hazy

risers.why: The volume moved to him and stayed.
risers.verdict: Stove's on. Treat him as a weekly WR2.

fallers.stat: Snap share 61% to 44% over three weeks
fallers.why: The rookie is taking the early-down work.
fallers.verdict: Left to cool. Trade him away while the name still carries weight; ask for a WR3 with a role.
fallers.price: Ask for a WR3 with a role
